text:
Maya: Heads-up: noticed ~$42.7k in GPU charges attributed to project 'image-eval' over the past 4 days. A lot of rows are untagged and some show service_account=eval-harness which should be limited by quota. Can we triage and decide allocation before month close? cc @Owen @Priyanka

cost-bot: Alert: GPU spend spike detected for project image-eval. Delta +$42,732 in 96h. Export: https://billing.internal/exports/1912349999-image-eval-spike.csv

Owen: Yikes. Do we have the export sample? I want instance types and meter_ids.

Maya: paste (trimmed):
```
2026-03-18T22:11Z, inst-44a, n1-highmem-32, europe-west1, gpu-a100, 12.4, eval-harness
2026-03-18T22:12Z, inst-44b, n1-highmem-32, europe-west1, gpu-a100, 12.1, eval-harness
2026-03-19T05:03Z, inst-58c, n1-standard-16, us-central1, gpu-a10, 1.3, NULL
```

Priyanka: Looks like the eval harness used service account that bypassed the owner's quota after a config change on 2026-03-17. Platform ops alerted and reverted, but billing already incurred.

Owen: For allocation options: (1) charge Product (Image) full amount, (2) split 75/25 Product/Platform, or (3) provisional internal credit from Platform and pursue vendor case. I lean to option 3: provisional internal coverage then reconcile.

Maya: Agree. Can we authorize an internal advance of $15k from Platform contingency for now? We'll file a vendor case for meter correction and return funds if credited. Also need backfill tags so dashboards stop showing untagged spikes.

Priyanka: Vendor case procedure: collect CSV of meter_ids + instance_ids + timestamps and open billing_support ticket. I can draft the CSV. Also we'll run a targeted SQL backfill to set label='eval-harness-fallback' and attributed_team='image' for rows matching the CSV. Dry-run first.

FinanceOpsBot: Action required: submit FIN-REQ for provisional coverage. Suggested ledger lines: PLAT-ADV-2026 (Platform advance) debit $15,000, IMAGE-PROD-2026 credit provisional $27,732. Include memo: "provisional advance for eval harness quota bypass; pending vendor credit (Case TBD)"

Owen: I'll approve the $15k provisional advance. Please tag transaction FIN-2026-0529 and record GL PLAT-OPS-2026 for the advance. Maya, please confirm when backfill dry-run and when CSV ready for ticket.

Maya: Will run dry-run tonight and share results in #eng-infra. CSV will be attached to vendor case. Also will include a note to sales/product if any external customer runs were correlated.

Priyanka: Opening billing_support case now and attaching initial CSV. Case created: 200998. ETA 4-7 business days for vendor reply. I'll update here when they respond.

Owen: Once vendor responds we'll reconcile: if credit granted, reverse internal advance proportionally; if denied, finalize allocation with Product absorbing remaining. Leaving thread open until Case 200998 resolves.

Maya: Thanks. Will post dry-run and final backfill status. :thumbsup:
